slides.say: This counter goes up every click. But the screen never shows it.
Changing ref dot current does not trigger a render. The value changes, but React never redraws the button.

slides.text: State: setting it re-renders, and each render gets a fixed snapshot. Ref: change .current any time, no re-render.
slides.say: State triggers a re-render, and each render sees a fixed snapshot. A ref is mutable, and changing it never re-renders.
So use refs for things the screen doesn’t show, like an interval I D you need later to stop a timer.

slides.text: Shown on screen? State. Only needed by handlers? A ref.
slides.say: The rule: if the value is used for rendering, keep it in state. If only handlers need it, a ref is enough.
